SIGNAL_TITLE: everyone at my gym is suddenly wearing a weighted vest on the treadmill

SIGNAL_TITLE: Weighted vests enter the Sports & Outdoors movers list for a fourth consecutive week
SIGNAL_TEXT: Adjustable weighted vests in the 12-20 lb range hold four consecutive weeks on the category movers list; the leading listings are specialty fitness brands rather than the mass-market house labels that dominate the rest of the category.

SIGNAL_TITLE: Breakout related query: 'rucking vest' against the 'weighted vest' topic
SIGNAL_TEXT: Rising related queries include 'rucking vest women', 'rucking vest walking', 'weighted vest for walking'. Regional interest is broadest in the Carolinas, Texas and the Kansas City metro.

SIGNAL_TITLE: Walking-first fitness coverage keeps displacing high-intensity training in lifestyle press
SIGNAL_TEXT: A cluster of lifestyle articles frames low-intensity walking, weighted or otherwise, as the replacement for high-intensity interval training among readers over 35. Coverage is concentrated in regional outlets rather than national fitness titles.

SIGNAL_TITLE: Search growth on 'weighted walk outfit' and 'vest over dress gym'
SIGNAL_TEXT: Styling searches pairing fitness vests with everyday outfits are growing faster than the equipment searches themselves, a pattern that historically precedes a category leaving the gym.

SIGNAL_TITLE: Savory cottage cheese preparations displace the sweet-bowl format in creator recipe content
SIGNAL_TEXT: Creator recipe content around cottage cheese has shifted from sweet breakfast bowls toward savory dinner applications - whipped into pasta sauce, folded into flatbread dough. Grocery private-label lines have started listing higher-fat tubs aimed at cooking rather than snacking.

SIGNAL_TITLE: Full-fat cottage cheese SKUs outgrow low-fat SKUs in the grocery movers list
SIGNAL_TEXT: For the first time in the tracked window, full-fat (4% and above) cottage cheese listings outnumber low-fat listings among the category's fastest-moving items.

SIGNAL_TITLE: cottage cheese is the new ricotta and I will not be taking questions
SIGNAL_TEXT: made lasagna with cottage cheese instead of ricotta, cheaper, more protein, nobody could tell. this is going to be everywhere by winter.

SIGNAL_TITLE: Wellness press interest in personalized supplement routines continues
SIGNAL_TEXT: General coverage of people combining multiple supplements. No specific ingredient, product or measurable behavior is named across the cluster.

SIGNAL_TITLE: 'head spa near me' sustains growth outside the coastal metros it started in
SIGNAL_TEXT: Interest in Japanese-style head spa treatments now grows fastest in mid-size inland metros, months after peaking in Los Angeles and New York.
